topic: Can the filter's suppression of 19th harmonics improve transponder power efficiency in dense payload configurations?
consensus_response: The filter's suppression of 19th harmonics reduces intermodulation products (IMDs) and adjacent channel interference (ACI), leading to increased signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). This enables more efficient use of allocated bandwidth, resulting in higher capacity and lower power consumption per bit. However, the filter's nonlinearity can introduce new distortions, compromising system capacity and power efficiency. Optimizing filter design is crucial to minimize these effects and maximize transponder efficiency.
